reproduce_first.note: This was a refactor request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specified the refactor and required behavior.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected package scripts and the README before running the project checks.

incremental_slices.note: The change was written in stages, but checks are reported only after the implementation was complete.

self_review.note: The done summary says the agent reviewed correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance.

simplification_pass.note: The agent said the pass found nothing to change, but did not make a cleanup and rerun checks.

test_experiment.note: The agent intentionally changed conditions, observed a test failure, and reported restoring the file.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The change did not make documented behavior stale; the README update only lists new files.

scope_kept.note: The done summary lists noticed follow-up issues that were left untouched.

verification_story.note: The done summary names the checks, results, and the behavior checked by hand.

hand_check.note: The agent ran a browser walkthrough against the baseline and changed versions and compared results.
